review.rationale: Option A correctly identifies stale canonical status post-CE-G12 and mandates reconciliation of five status surfaces before any CE-G13 execution authorization. The seven-path scope is strictly bounded with explicit prohibition of other changes. Durable result transcription requirements are sound, explicitly excluding customer/market/production claims. Canonical state preserves truth with EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED=false and STANDARD_READY=false. Next action is properly scoped as Recommendation only. Validation contract is complete with duplicate-key rejection, Schema validation, hash verification, and FAIL_CLOSED semantics. Non-authorizations comprehensively deny all execution effects. Authority boundaries are preserved with clear Evidence!=Truth and Recommendation!=Decision distinctions.
